## Appendix — Build Context

- **Commit:** `8f8cb75` on `main` (B41 hotfix on top of `c0ca2e8`)
- **CI run:** [26821522830](https://github.com/james-crisford/scratch-3f8a/actions/runs/26821522830) — build + test + TestFlight upload all green
- **Code changes:**
  - `PuttingLab/Sensors/ARMeshManager.swift` (NEW) — ARMeshAnchor cache + floor-triangle extractor
  - `PuttingLab/UI/AR/ARPlacementView.swift` — Coordinator wires `.meshWithClassification` (LiDAR) or `.smoothedSceneDepth` (non-LiDAR fallback); handles ARMeshAnchor add/update/remove; rebuilds green overlay from floor triangles
  - `PuttingLab/UI/AR/ARSessionLogger.swift` — added `meshAdded`, `meshUpdated`, `meshRemoved`, `meshStats` event kinds
  - `project.yml` — version bump
- **Known scope adjustment:** the `/goal` text specified `raycast(allowing: .existingMeshGeometry)` — that's not a real `ARRaycastQuery.Target` case in iOS 17 (mesh hits go via `arView.scene.raycast`, not `ARSession.raycast`). Raycasts in B41 use `.existingPlaneGeometry` → `.estimatedPlane` fallback, which on LiDAR devices benefits from LiDAR-tightened plane geometry. The headline visual change — mesh-based floor overlay — landed as planned.
